product_one_liner.value: Levitate is an AI-powered relationship-intelligence and marketing platform for small businesses, helping them identify which clients need attention, what to say, and when to reach out.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes the product and its small-business audience.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans page exists; it describes its plan and add-ons, though the core plan price is available by contacting sales.

named_customers.notes: Both organizations appear in the company's customer success stories.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn gives the 201–500 employee band; Levitate's story page separately reports 400+ team members.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists the headquarters as Raleigh, North Carolina.

founded_year.notes: The company story gives 2017 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog index shows marketing, educational and product-update content; it does not show at least two engineering posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center has multiple product documentation categories and articles, including AI, integrations, setup and troubleshooting.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open job board lists five current roles, none titled AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM or computer vision.

model_provider.notes: Levitate's AI Model Providers page names Anthropic PBC, Google LLC, and OpenAI, LLC.

compliance_certs.notes: Levitate's Trust Center publicly names SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA and PCI DSS. No other listed certification is included.

last_funding.notes: The March 5, 2026 announcement reports a $16 million round but does not specify the round stage.

raised_18mo.notes: The announced $16 million funding round was in March 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists Sales Development Representative openings in Raleigh, Tampa and Toronto, as well as a Manager, Account Executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 25, 2026, Levitate announced four new AI-powered features, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page lists the current executive team but does not establish when its members joined or whether any executive departed; no verifiable dated change was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These CRM systems are explicitly named on Levitate's integrations page.
